en.title: File Transfer Segments — Count Unique After Each Byte
en.description: Bytes arrive one at a time; after each arrival, count the file segments that have been completely received. A segment covers the half-open interval [start,start+length).
en.input: n m; then n lines `start length`; the last line contains m non-negative byte offsets. Site supplement: n,m≤1000, total interval length ≤20000, offsets ≤200000.
en.output: Output m integers separated by spaces; the i-th number is the number of completed segments after the first i bytes have arrived.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process the operations one by one according to the definitions, and watch the boundaries.
